title: werauhia glutinosa
intro: Werauhia glutinosa, commonly known as 'Blue Samoan', is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae, native to Samoa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Samoan medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Werauhia glutinosa include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Werauhia glutinosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-viral, anti-bacterial, and anti-fungal properties.
